name: Trello
summary: Kanban-style project management app: boards, lists and cards, with automation, templates and integrations.
description: Visual project management for teams: boards of lists and cards track tasks and projects, with Inbox capture, Planner scheduling, Butler automation, Power-Ups and integrations, a template gallery and an MCP server for AI tools.
contains: boards with lists and cards for task and project management
free plan for individuals and small teams
Premium at $10 per user/month with unlimited automation
template gallery for marketing, product, engineering and design teams
Butler automation, Power-Ups and app integrations
Inbox and Planner for capturing and scheduling work
MCP server to connect Trello to AI tools
